name: Type Model
description: Global ambient type declarations defining the Window.electronAPI IPC contract interface and domain types (EditorState, WorkspaceState, DirEntry). The single source of truth for the renderer-main process API contract across 9 namespaces.

declarations.name: EditorState
declarations.description: Per-plugin editor serialization state: open file tabs, active file, explorer splitter width, per-file cursor/scroll positions

declarations.name: WorkspaceState
declarations.description: Full workspace session state: plugin array with uuids/positions/dimensions, z-order stack, zoom/pan viewport

declarations.name: DirEntry
declarations.description: Filesystem directory entry: name string plus isDirectory boolean

declarations.name: Window.electronAPI
declarations.description: Top-level IPC bridge namespace. 8 namespaces: window, terminal, workspace, shell, prefs, git, clipboard, fs. Plus top-level platform (string) and versions ({node, chrome, electron, app}) fields.
